LanguageData.Heyra_Setting_Credit: Revived for 1.6 and 1.7 · original art, lore and heart by Bando
LanguageData.Heyra_Setting_MilksoyLoomFuel: Synthread loom also accepts milksoy as fuel
LanguageData.Heyra_Setting_MilksoyLoomFuelDesc: Lets colonists fill the synthread loom with milksoy, not just bean pulp.
LanguageData.Heyra_Setting_UnrestrictedApparel: Heyra and Rong can wear any apparel
LanguageData.Heyra_Setting_UnrestrictedApparelDesc: Removes the race apparel restriction, so Heyra and Rong can wear clothes from the base game and other mods.
LanguageData.Heyra_Setting_RestartNote: Changes take effect after restarting RimWorld.
